title: ElseLife experience boundary v1
description: Canonical Go/Rust experience JSON. No task completion or credential fields. All IDs in candidate are provisional domain keys; backend owns formal revision and history.

known.description: Disclosed to the reader in this branch at this revision; not cross-branch human memory or character knowledge.

known_by.description: Entities who know this fact in the story. Independent from reader disclosure.

resolved_at_revision.description: Go-written formal revision at which this stable thread identity was resolved. Null (or omitted in an old stored body) means still open. New candidate threads must have null; only resolve_thread_ids can cause Go to stamp the next formal revision. Resolution preserves the object/identity and existing relationships; its ID cannot be rebound to a new topic.

version.description: Boundary format version. v2 adds state_coverage and read_request; a v1 consumer must reject v2 payloads rather than read an incomplete state as complete.

state.description: Generation-visible state materialized by the backend under state_coverage. This is NOT authority: the backend applies candidates with its full pinned authority state, and an object omitted here still binds later prose.

history_complete.description: Whether all formal pages 1..revision are present. If false, history is a contiguous full-text latest-page suffix ending at revision. Full formal history stays stored and read-addressable. Omitted pages are not undetermined world state. This dimension is independent of state_coverage.

state_coverage.description: Server-computed honesty object about the materialized generation state. It describes EXACT current-authority membership, never model confidence, never rank, never archival retirement. omitted=0 with complete=true is the only complete case. A deferred object is still current authority: not false, not undetermined, not free to recreate.

policy.description: Go owns this named deterministic materialization policy. Policy+recent_from_revision are frozen for one accepted operation, not stored world truth; changing policy in a later software revision never rewrites snapshots.

recent_from_revision.description: Lowest revision whose newly introduced facts/entities are mandatory roots under rules-secrets-open-recent-closure.v1; 0 for full.v1 or stage-scene-selection.v1. Scene selection does not promise inclusion of every recent object.

total.description: Full pinned current-authority object counts for the audience of this context.

omitted.description: Counts of current-authority objects whose bodies were deferred from this generation input. included + omitted = total.

complete.description: True iff included set equals full pinned current authority (bodies and relations). Must be false whenever any omitted count is nonzero.

source_handle.description: Opaque backend-issued read authority bound to authenticated account + experience + branch + base revision + operation fence. Read authority, not narrative data; never accepted from the model.

audience.description: Go chooses author for story generation and reader for ask. Reader counts/objects/handles are scoped to facts already revealed at the frozen base revision; never leaked author cardinalities.

recalls.description: Backend-issued raw read replies within this frozen operation, zero initially. Historical bodies retain snapshot coordinates, never merge blindly into current state. Readers/ask only receive reader-projected replies.

read_budget.description: Go-declared finite within-operation read budget; read_budget never authorizes extra model calls (those are separately bounded by RuntimeFacts.remaining_model_calls). 0 reads disables retrieval. Exhaustion terminates this attempt rather than silently freeing deferred authority.

read_request.description: Read-only retrieval inside the SAME accepted operation, issued by the generator when its bounded input cannot satisfy the task. Never a story page, never a revision advance, never a candidate. Backend authorizes, pins, matches literally and returns raw committed source.

source_handle.description: Must echo the handle from the generation state_coverage; a model cannot mint read authority.

type.description: Only entities have a name in this domain schema; facts/threads use literal text selectors.

selector.description: Closed literal selectors. Names only target entity.name; facts/threads have text and use enumerate. Terms match text for facts/threads and name+description for entities, with case-sensitive Unicode literal all/any semantics (not similarity). Ambiguity enumerates every exact match in stable typed-ID order with query-computed complete/cursor; never an arbitrary best pick.

read_object.description: Typed object from the exact returned snapshot. Author reads preserve raw fields and text. Reader reads FIRST apply deterministic reader projection P at that snapshot (known objects; hidden subject/known_by/related_ids/related_fact_ids filtered), THEN preserve visible text verbatim. Permission filtering of relation metadata is explicit, not a claim that all author fields are returned verbatim. type must agree with body; historical bodies never blindly replace current state; identity uses (type,id,as_of_revision), not ID alone.

receipt.description: Trace hash recipe: UTF-8 compact JSON tree, all object keys sorted by UTF-8 lexical order, integers exact (no float roundtrip), non-ASCII strings raw except Go-compatible escapes for < > & U+2028 U+2029 plus JSON controls. query_sha256 hashes full ReadRequest including selector cursor/budget/ID/handle. body_sha256 hashes full ReadReply WITHOUT receipt. Hashes prove byte consistency, never authorization or semantic use.

read_reply.description: Backend-issued result of one exact read predicate at a frozen account/experience/branch/base/fence. complete describes enumeration of THIS literal predicate, NOT importance or semantic understanding. Missing results are not creative blanks. Reader counts and existence are projected. receipt hashes are trace-integrity evidence, not authorization or proof of semantic use. Source authority comes from the authenticated channel and frozen operation, not from the hashes.

read_failure.description: Sanitized result.experience_read failure. It has no raw object/name or account data. Scope mismatch or unavailable revision terminates the generation operation, not a hidden fallback to legacy strategy. Capacity/budget failures do not authorize guessed replacement facts.

generation_result.description: Model structured-output wrapper. Root remains an object for structured-output APIs; only a candidate OR a read request is allowed within result. Read replies/coverage are never model outputs. The final decision.experience wire payload remains a bare canonical Candidate.

reader_record.description: Evidence-only structured attachment on an immutable formal fact. All values must be established by this fact; no inferred coordinates, holdings, quantities or permissions. Does not authorize local state changes.

participant_ids.description: Existing entity IDs relevant to this scene, not display names.

relationship_targets.description: Existing entity IDs for relationship counterparts, not names or relationship descriptions. Put natural-language relationship descriptions in topics.

topics.description: Natural-language retrieval topics and relationship descriptions.

fact_ids.description: Existing fact IDs needed for this scene.

prior_source_count.description: Total older sources in this stored entry. Selected locators and quotes may cover only a subset.

prior_source_revisions.description: Bounded original-page locators selected for this material; not an assertion that all older sources are listed.

prior_sources.description: Selected exact older quotes, each also listed in prior_source_revisions. requires_source remains true when any stored original quote is omitted.
